calibration.method: normalised conformal expansion by event and horizon; uncensored served labels only
calibration.limitation: Temporal dependence, censored labels and event shifts can defeat coverage; field validation required.

robustness.protocol: Exogenous demand shifts with frozen histories/forecasts; sensitivity, not independent field data or a closed-loop backtest

limitations: No measured upay agent, DSO, revenue or retention outcomes.
Customers-at-risk is a failure-count proxy, not distinct customers or observed churn.
Synthetic feature and pipeline ablations do not establish causal value in production.

scale.limitations: Feature construction timed only at original population. Larger runs replicate existing feature rows and balances; excludes streaming ingestion, database, HTTP, concurrency and retraining.
